news.title: XARENA ESPORTS is live
news.body: XARENA ESPORTS officially launches today — a professional Free Fire esports organisation built for competitive squads. Season 1 is announced, registrations are open, and the arena is being prepared. This is day one.

news.title: Official roster recruitment open
news.body: XARENA is building its founding roster. IGLs, rushers, snipers and support players — if you grind Free Fire seriously, send your tryout application from the Teams page. Early recruits get priority for Season 1 squad placement.

rules:
RRs
Rules and Regulations

  These rules apply to every XARENA tournament, scrim and squad. By registering you accept them.

  1 · Fair play

    1.1 No hacks, mods, scripts or aimbots. Instant ban.

    1.2 No emulators unless the tournament allows them.

    1.3 No teaming with other squads, stream sniping or deliberate bug abuse.

    1.4 Match-fixing or throwing a match means a ban.

  2 · Registration and teams

    2.1 One account per player. UID and in-game name must be real.

    2.2 Play only on your own account. No account sharing.

    2.3 Squad size follows the tournament post. A locked squad can't change players once it starts.

    2.4 Fake details mean removal.

  3 · Conduct

    3.1 Respect players, hosts and admins. No abuse, hate or threats.

    3.2 No spam or fake screenshots.

    3.3 Never share room IDs or passwords outside your squad.

  4 · Match day

    4.1 Join the room 10 minutes early. Late squads may lose their slot.

    4.2 Take room details only from the host's official post.

    4.3 No substitutes after the match starts.

    4.4 The squad leader sends the result screenshot after each match.

  5 · Disputes

    5.1 Report within 15 minutes of the match ending, with proof.

    5.2 No proof, no review. The admin's decision is final.

  6 · Penalties

    6.1 First small offence: warning.

    6.2 Bigger or repeated offences: match loss or removal.

    6.3 Cheating or fake proof: permanent ban and loss of all points and rewards.

  7 · Entry, prizes and money (legal)

    7.1 Entry to every XARENA tournament, cup and LAN event is free for all players. There is no entry fee, no registration charge and no in-app purchase - ever.

    7.2 Prizes are sponsor-funded. The named sponsor funds the prize and pays winners directly. XARENA runs the event and never holds prize money.

    7.3 XARENA never collects money from players in any form - no fees, no deposits, no betting, no cash conversion of points. Points, XP and badges on the platform are rewards for playing and can never be bought or redeemed for cash.

    7.4 Free entry plus a sponsor-funded prize is the standard, legal community-tournament model. There is no wagering or gambling element in any XARENA event.

  By registering for any XARENA event you accept these rules. Register your squad.

drills.title: Crosshair placement basics
steps: Keep your crosshair at head height wherever you move - never at the floor.
Walk common angles on Bermuda in training grounds for 5 minutes, holding head level.
Snap between two fixed points (door frames) 30 times, smooth not fast.

drills.title: Drag headshots (one-tap style)
steps: In training grounds, scope a red dot and drag upward through the head line - 20 reps slow.
Repeat at 2x speed. Misses are fine; rhythm first.
Finish with 10 drag attempts on moving dummies.

drills.title: Jiggle peeking
steps: Pick a corner. Peek out 0.3s, back in - bait the shot, never commit.
Add a crouch at the end of every third peek.
Drill both left and right sides, 2 minutes each.

drills.title: Gloo wall under pressure
steps: Have a friend (or a bot lobby) push you - wall first, then think.
Drill: wall + side-step + heal in under 4 seconds.
Practice walling mid-sprint, 15 reps.

drills.title: Reading the zone
steps: Before the first zone closes, say your rotation route out loud.
Rotate EARLY on edge, LATE only with hard cover.
After each match, write one line: what killed my rotation?

drills.title: High ground priority
steps: In your next 5 matches, take the highest ground inside zone before minute 6.
Note which compounds give sightlines into the next zone.
Trade kills for position - never the other way.

drills.title: Trade fragging
steps: Never peek alone: pair up and peek 1 second apart.
If your teammate goes down, your job is the trade, not the rescue.
Call damage numbers instantly - "70 on one" wins fights.

drills.title: IGL comms drill
steps: One voice per fight: the IGL calls, everyone else reports only.
Use short calls: location, count, action. "Two, hill 30, push on my mark."
Debrief 2 minutes after each match: one good call, one bad call.
